rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday description for a person who smokes.

example.traditional: 食煙嘅人唔可以喺呢度食煙。
example.jyutping: sik6 jin1 ge3 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 dou6 sik6 jin1

rows.note: Use this compact established noun when referring to smokers as a social group or category.

example.english: A smoker usually can't quit smoking that easily.
example.traditional: 煙民通常唔係咁容易戒煙。
example.jyutping: jin1 man4 tung1 soeng4 m4 hai6 gam3 jung4 ji6 gaai3 jin1
